methodology: Polymeric Precision Doping (PPD) involves the Semiconductor grafting reaction of functionalized dopant polymers, where the molecular weight of the dopant polymers plays a crucial role in achieving precise control over the doping process.
research_objective: To explore and validate Polymeric Precision Doping (PPD) as an emerging technology for downscaling microelectronic devices.

key_findings.finding: Polymeric Precision Doping (PPD) has proven to be a promising candidate for precise control of dopant atom dose in semiconductive substrates.
The molecular weight of the dopant polymers is an effective key for precise control of doping process.
High temperature (950-1000°C) annealing is required to activate dopant atoms in silicon
Doping techniques such as CVD lack dose control and homogeneity of dopant atoms
Ultra-shallow junctions can be achieved by diffusing dopant atoms just 10-15 nm deep in silicon using Rapid Thermal Annealing (RTA) process.
The presence of interstitial dopant atoms promotes the diffusion process and improves the activation efficiency of dopants.
Localized doping process implemented by combining MLD technique with lithography
